interpretation: No mass-admissible 10 mm case survives a 30-minute eclipse after the first complete package conductance budget is propagated, even at the optimistic emissivity target. Electrical energy remains sufficient in all declared cases; thermal retention fails in all declared cases. This is a screening-model falsifier, not hardware qualification.
limitations: Emissivity values are model targets or screening proxies, not qualified package measurements.
Package conductance dimensions and properties remain explicit screening assumptions.
PCM sensible heat, containment mass, contact resistance, internal radiation, temperature dependence, and tolerance distributions remain omitted.
Illuminated-state heat rejection is outside this eclipse-retention gate.
